title: 49 moments we are unsure about (about 37 minutes)
intro: More short clips from the Oct 8, 9 and 10 lessons. A computer check thinks the student may have made a mistake in each one, but you have not checked it yet. Each card shows the student's words, the possible mistake and a possible fix (both are a computer's guess and may be wrong), and your own words just before and after. Listen, tap what is true. Writing why is optional but helps most. Saved as you tap - stop any time and come back from your Tutor page. The time on each card is how far into the lesson it was.
